name: Kangoku Senkan ~Hidou no Sennou Kaizou Koukai~
original_name: 監獄戦艦～非道の洗脳改造航海～
source:
The next target of the captain of the battleship Jasant, Major. Donny Bohgan, is beautiful army officers Rieri Bishop and Naomi Evans who have an inordinate level of popularity among people, and also, are Donny's hateful enemies he got hurt by.

Brainwash the two female officers in the space battleship and give them a hard time to change them into someone else.

[Edited from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE030340]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
战舰“贾桑特号”舰长唐尼·博根少校将下一个目标锁定在莉耶莉·毕晓普与娜奥米·埃文斯身上——这两名貌美的女军官不仅在民众中拥有极高人气，更是曾重创过唐尼、令他恨之入骨的宿敌。

在宇宙战舰上对两名女军官实施洗脑与残酷折磨，将她们彻底改造成判若两人的玩物吧。

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE030340]DLsite English[/url]]
